user_prompt: I need to pull together a comprehensive view of our current operational health by analyzing both our recent campaign safety incidents and engagement issues alongside our product economics to understand cost drivers and supplier dependencies—so I can brief leadership on where we're experiencing the most friction across both customer-facing and manufacturing operations.

steps.step_name: Analyze our recent campaign safety incidents and engagement issues to identify operational friction points in our customer-facing operations
Provide a comprehensive analysis of product economics including cost drivers and supplier dependencies to understand manufacturing operational constraints

intent_resolver.reason: The request is a strategic analytics and briefing exercise requiring ad-hoc synthesis across multiple operational domains (safety incidents, engagement, product economics, supplier dependencies) rather than execution of any single registered end-to-end process.

sub_queries: Analyze our recent campaign safety incidents and engagement issues to identify operational friction points
Analyze our product economics including cost drivers and supplier dependencies
Synthesize insights from safety incidents, engagement issues, and product economics into a comprehensive operational health briefing for leadership
